accepted_limitations: This is a source-only review. It grants no execution, retry, resume, refill, overwrite, training, scientific-claim, navigation, promotion, deployment, or successor authority.

The separately authorized follow-on, if explicitly issued, is one non-citable sizing_calibration_only V2 successor attempt over eight calibration scenes, sixteen states, and 160 branches. It performs no model training and establishes no world-model generalization, recursive-rollout, planning-regret, or closed-loop navigation result.

Calibration V1 is permanently consumed. V2 has a distinct attempt ID and fresh output root; no V1 attempt-root file may be copied, linked, resumed, refilled, overwritten, or admitted as V2 output. The ordinary pre-existing scene and runtime inputs remain eligible only because they are not V1 attempt artifacts.

The exact V2 plan preserves the V1 scientific design and changes only attempt identity and output root. The calibration panel, histories, requested actions, deterministic sentinels, branch horizons, target coordinates, runtime bindings, render contract, and execution contract are unchanged.

Only the exact repository registry low_rgb_texture, near_wall_depth, and near_forward_geometry is retained as low-information navigation content. Every unknown, malformed, technical-corruption, unresolved-camera-safety, or mixed low-information-plus-hard reason still fails closed.

Retained low-information frames are explicitly tagged in frame receipts and downstream artifacts and are counted overall and by context, target, and reason in the calibration receipt. This stratification does not establish visual-domain fidelity or make low-information observations representative of production frequency.

The renderer uses solid materials and box-physics geometry. A completed calibration therefore establishes no parity with the textured training RGB domain and cannot support a visual-domain fidelity claim.

Repeated-action sentinels remain an exact deterministic replay gate. They do not estimate a stochastic noise distribution; the physical-rank contract continues to use the fixed 1e-6 m numerical floor.
Physical fall, tip, progress, path, and endpoint trajectories are receipted at the 50 Hz policy cadence. They do not establish 2 ms swept clearance, contact, recoverability, or production safety.
GPU memory telemetry is selected-device global VRAM sampled from sysfs and is not process-attributed. Concurrent GPU work can inflate the baseline, peak, and delta.
The authority network_access=false field is a policy restriction, not network-namespace isolation. Installed third-party package contents are version-receipted rather than recursively hash-closed.
The eight exact ordinary TRAIN scene IDs are calibration-only identities and must remain excluded from future train and evaluation roles by the successful downstream calibration contract.

The V2 output root must remain absent until supervised reservation. Any post-reservation failure consumes V2; the failed-result terminal binding repair preserves diagnostics but grants no retry, resume, refill, overwrite, or partial promotion.
A successful supervisor run remains COMPLETE_PENDING_TERMINAL_REVIEW. Only an independently terminally reviewed FREEZE_PILOT_CONTRACT receipt can satisfy the downstream calibration gate.

This review did not mint authority, launch the simulator, create the V2 attempt root, decode RGB leaves, deserialize checkpoint tensors, inspect sealed or test-split payloads, or alter any source or test file.
